fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution from an Alternate Data Stream (ADS). Adversaries may use NTFS file attributes to hide their malicious data in order to evade detection
fields.name: Execute From Alternate Data Streams
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "txt:" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "type " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " > ") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "makecab " and tgt.process.cmdline contains ".cab") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "reg " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " export ") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "regedit " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " /E ") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "esentutl " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " /y " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " /d " and tgt.process.cmdline contains " /o "))))
